test_title: PYST 161: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 08 Feb, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some chairs are beds.

Some tables are desks.

All beds are tables.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some chairs are tables.

II. Some desks are beds.

III. Some desks are chairs.
solution:
Given Statements:

Some chairs are beds.

Some tables are desks.

All beds are tables.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/957929d7b55657187d1531e8f7cafb8f1488b52153539334b79248e22c0a24c9.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some chairs are tables - True (Because, Those part of Chairs which is Beds is also Tables).

II. Some desks are beds - False (Because, No definite relation given between Desks and Beds, so it can be possible only).

III. Some desks are chairs - False (Because, No definite relation given between Desks and Chairs, so it can be possible only).

So, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
